messages:
maria: Heads up — we're seeing a burst of 503s out of hosted inference in us-west-2 since ~09:42 UTC. Customer-impacting. Gateway shows upstream worker exits with SIGSEGV and GPU OOM interleaved. :warning:

sanjeev: Copy. Any pattern on model or context length?

maria: Mostly during model swap/scale events for model: rdx-large-v2, QPS ~1200. Memory spikes right before segfaults. Logs show kernel panic in attention kernel.

irene: Pasting recent container logs snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T09:42:53Z] infer-runner[pid:4321] WARNING: prefetched_kv_size=14.2GB
[2026-03-15T09:42:54Z] infer-runner[pid:4321] ERROR: cudaMemcpy failed: out of memory
[2026-03-15T09:42:54Z] infer-runner[pid:4321] FATAL: seghandler: PC=0x7f9a... attn_cuda_kernel+0x1f3
[2026-03-15T09:42:54Z] kernel: NVRM: GPU at 0000:3b:00.0: GPU has fallen off the bus
```

amy-cs: Customer reported 20% error rate on their requests hitting long-context prompts. They filed a ticket — CS needs ETA and mitigation.

devon: Immediate mitigation: enable fallback routing to dedicated-gpu-pool (lower perf) and reduce max_batch_size to 1 for rdx-large-v2 for the next 15m. Rolling out now.

ops-bot: Routing policy updated: route rdx-large-v2 -> dedicated-gpu-pool (temp) by policy fallback/503-mitigation at 09:48 UTC.

maria: Thanks. Can SRE collect core dump and nvml traces? Sanjeev, can you share repro steps to reproduce locally?

sanjeev: Repro is flaky but here are quick steps that hit the same kernel path:
1) Start runner with 2x prefetched KV workers.
2) Send long-context requests (>= 16k tokens) concurrently (QPS ~200) while swapping quantized variant.
3) Observe mem pressure and occasional cudaMemcpy OOM then segfault.

Also attaching a gdb backtrace snippet from a debug node:
```
#0 0x00007f9a1234 in attn_cuda_kernel(...)
#1 0x00007f9a2345 in run_forward(...)
#2 0x000055aa7766 in main_loop
```

irene: We're collecting GPU metrics and nvml logs — uploading to /srv/infra/triage/5421009876. Noticed nvml reports memory_free dropping to <200MB before crash.

amy-cs: Please confirm temporary routing to dedicated pool and estimated rollback time so I can tell the customer.

devon: Routing enabled at 09:48 UTC. Plan: keep fallback for 30m, monitor errors. If stable, we'll rollback routing and gradually increase batch_size.

sanjeev: Proposed fix: increase prefetch memory limit, stall model swap until KV flush completes, and add guard to disallow quant swap when free_mem < 1GB. I'll open PR for runtime guard and a hotfix to avoid in-place quant swap.

maria: Assigning follow-ups: @sanjeev PR + hotfix, @irene upload full nvml+core dump, @devon keep fallback routing and watch for regression. CS @amy-cs to update customer with ETA ~2h.

amy-cs: Acknowledged. I'll send initial update and escalate to account team.

devon: Observability note: creating a short-term alert: upstream_worker_exit_rate > 3/min for model rdx-large-v2 -> page oncall if firing.

sanjeev: Quick log grep command if needed: `kubectl logs -l app=infer-runner -c runner --since=10m | grep -E "cudaMemcpy|seghandler|out of memory"`

immediate_next_steps: collect stacks + nvml dump, roll routing, limit batch_size, prepare hotfix PR.

maria: Closing loop here — will update thread when hotfix merges or if we see further spikes. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
